Less: Urine bag - List IV (part of cost of treatment)

letter_deductions.why: Clause 4.1.1(v): road ambulance max 2,000 per hospitalisation.

notes: Ambulance: List I item 67 lists "AMBULANCE" as not payable, but Clause 4.1.1(v) specifically covers road ambulance up to 2,000 per hospitalisation; the specific benefit is applied (2,000 paid, 800 deducted). Floater SI remaining 4,30,300 (by paid) / 4,24,000 (by admitted) - not binding.
